phrases.latin: Nucēs Octōbrī. Quaere sub jūglande; fortasse ūna manet.
phrases.english: Nuts are in October. Look under the walnut tree; maybe one is left.

sources: Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026, with their glosses. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word; classical passages are cited by author.
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency (printed page numbers): p. 298.
